in_marathi.name: Aniruddh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Another name for Krishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aniruddh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aniruddha is a name of Lord Krishna, meaning 'Another Rudra'. Rudra is a name of Lord Shiva, meaning 'The One Who Causes Tremendous Agitation'. Aniruddha, therefore, means 'Another Shiva'.

in_bengali.name: Aniruddh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Another name for Krishna
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aniruddh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Aniruddha is a name of Lord Krishna, meaning 'Another Rudra'. Rudra is a name of Lord Shiva, meaning 'The One Who Causes Tremendous Agitation'. Aniruddha, therefore, means 'Another Shiva'.
